thread.title: New High For Apple But These 5 Other NASDAQ Favorites Failed To Get There

author: admin
title: New High For Apple But These 5 Other NASDAQ Favorites Failed To Get There
text:
New High For Apple But These 5 Other NASDAQ Favorites Failed To Get There
&l;p&g;&l;img class=&q;size-full wp-image-3306&q; src=&q;http://blogs-images.forbes.com/johnnavin/files/2018/05/NDXA200-5-5-18.jpg?width=960&q; alt=&q;&q; data-height=&q;546&q; data-width=&q;1240&q;&g; NASDAQ 100 stocks above their 200-day moving average.
Apple hit a new high on Friday after a good earnings report and as the market closed I found myself checking the other big name NASDAQ tech stocks to see if the good vibe was being shared. I was surprised to see that those companies I would have expected to join the rally weren&s;t quite as strong as the leader of the pack.
The chart above confirms the basic overall tech weakness — that&s;s a picture of the number of stocks in the NASDAQ 100 index trading above their 200-day moving average. As you can see, this measure of strength peaked in January and is now failing to confirm the Apple new high as some kind of potential sign for the market&s;s health.
Here&s;s the Apple chart showing how — after a good earnings report –&a;nbsp; it just barely took out the previous high in March:
&l;img class=&q;size-full wp-image-3307&q; src=&q;http://blogs-images.forbes.com/johnnavin/files/2018/05/aapl-daily-5-5-18.jpg?width=960&q; alt=&q;&q; data-height=&q;546&q; data-width=&q;1240&q;&g; Apple chart.
Here are 5 other stocks in the NASDAQ 100 where new highs seemed elusive:
&l;img class=&q;size-full wp-image-3308&q; src=&q;http://blogs-images.forbes.com/johnnavin/files/2018/05/goog-5-5-18.jpg?width=960&q; alt=&q;&q; data-height=&q;546&q; data-width=&q;1240&q;&g; Alphabet (Google) chart.
&l;strong&g;Alphabet&l;/strong&g;, the stock formerly known as Google, had a nice pop on Friday but look how far below the previous high the closing price is. In January, it approached the 1200 level — now, after the rally that took Apple to a new high, Alphabet hit 1048. You can see on the chart that I&s;ve marked that 990 level with a dotted red line — it looks to be an area of importance from a support/resistance standpoint.
&l;!–nextpage–&g;
&l;img class=&q;size-full wp-image-3310&q; src=&q;http://blogs-images.forbes.com/johnnavin/files/2018/05/FB-daily-5-5-18.jpg?width=960&q; alt=&q;&q; data-height=&q;546&q; data-width=&q;1240&q;&g; Facebook chart.
&l;strong&g;Facebook&l;/strong&g; rallied on Friday and managed to close above the downtrend line connecting the February and March highs. Note that it remains way below the year&s;s high — down from 194 then to 176 now.&a;nbsp; The company is still dealing with the after effects and side effects of the Cambridge Analytica data usage.
&l;img class=&q;size-full wp-image-3313&q; src=&q;http://blogs-images.forbes.com/johnnavin/files/2018/05/AMGN-daily-5-5-18.jpg?width=960&q; alt=&q;&q; data-height=&q;546&q; data-width=&q;1240&q;&g; Amgen chart.
&l;strong&g;Amgen&l;/strong&g;, the big biotech company, has dropped from the January high of 199 to Friday&s;s close at about 168 — so it makes the list of NASDAQ 100 stocks not making the new high list. Forbes contributing writer David Trainer explains the current fundamentals and concludes that it&s;s undervalued &l;a href=&q;https://www.forbes.com/sites/greatspeculations/2018/05/03/understated-earnings-create-opportunity-in-these-three-stocks/?utm_source=yahoo&a;amp;utm_medium=partner&a;amp;utm_campaign=yahootix&a;amp;partner=yahootix&a;amp;yptr=yahoo#60a3eb2d79e9&q;&g;right here&l;/a&g;. I neither agree nor disagree but find it interesting.
&l;img class=&q;size-full wp-image-3314&q; src=&q;http://blogs-images.forbes.com/johnnavin/files/2018/05/sbux-daily-5-5-18.jpg?width=960&q; alt=&q;&q; data-height=&q;546&q; data-width=&q;1240&q;&g; Starbucks chart.
&l;strong&g;Starbucks&l;/strong&g; hit 61.50 in January, then sold off to 53.50 after some of &l;a href=&q;https://www.forbes.com/sites/dantedisparte/2018/04/22/starbucks-i-take-my-coffee-black/#26743a3c2bf4&q;&g;the worst publicity ever &l;/a&g;– and now trades at 57.68. The down trending red dotted line connecting that January high with the April high shows that even with the Friday rally, the big coffee shop chain remains below the trend.
&l;img class=&q;size-full wp-image-3315&q; src=&q;http://blogs-images.forbes.com/johnnavin/files/2018/05/QCOM-daily-5-5-18.jpg?width=960&q; alt=&q;&q; data-height=&q;546&q; data-width=&q;1240&q;&g; Qualcom chart.
&l;strong&g;Qualcom&l;/strong&g; rose from 49 to 68 in November when it seemed that Broadcom might be buying the company but that apparent deal ended when President Trump blocked it. You can see the effects of all this on the price of the stock over the past few months. It&s;s been a roller coaster ride from Qualcom investors. The upshot is, after the Friday rally, the stock hit 52 and that is still a long distance from the 68 in January.
&l;span&g;I do not hold positions in these stocks.&a;nbsp;&l;/span&g;&l;span&g;No recommendations are made one way or the other.&a;nbsp;&l;/span&g;&l;span&g;&a;nbsp;If you&s;re an investor, y&l;/span&g;&l;span&g;ou&s;d want to look much deeper into each of these situations. Always do your own independent research, due diligence and seek professional advice from a licensed investment adviser.&a;nbsp;&l;/span&g;
